findings.issue: observe() overwrites and deletes a pre-existing .durability-probe before a dirty target can be refused, violating no-overwrite guarantees.
Source HEAD is rechecked but source dirty state, artifacts, evidence and checkpoint are not: uncommitted source changes after observation still produce RESUMED_VERIFIED for a stale target.

TeamState auto-creates missing authority and ledgerIdentityDigest hashes only its pathname. Losing or replacing the original ledger at that pathname drops reservations and bypasses the source hard cap.
simulatedOverrides can overwrite providerKind and promote UNKNOWN to MANAGED_SANDBOX; only the explicitly simulated hard-fact keys should be accepted.
HOST_BOUND_CHECKPOINT unconditionally replaces DIVERGED after native copy hash failures, so corrupt goal/metrics/evidence copies can still satisfy the expected wrapper-refusal case.
Network interception and its attempt counter exist only in the observer process; actual fixture/version/verification children can attempt networking while receipts still claim networkAttempts=0.
Constructing file URLs with 'file://' + path truncates legal SDK checkout paths containing # and misinterprets percent escapes, breaking the documented replay command.

summary: Seven research-instrument defects were reproduced and repaired with regression tests while preserving the frozen author runtime evidence. The Git-Bash regression gate passes all 11 cases, and a fresh pinned-source Linux/Node22 replay passes all 38 cases. Full-product baseline testing has 1,968 passes and 9 unrelated failures in autopilot-completion, CLI configuration, and GitHub repair/quota checks; no production behavior was changed.
